movie.title: Angels of War
movie.overview: In November, at the very beginning of the terrible winter of 1941, when the blockade ring closes around Leningrad, a group of young iceboat athletes goes out onto the thin, not yet formed ice. The mission to deliver ammunition turns into an operation to save orphans from an orphanage who were not evacuated in time. Former rivals in regatta sports must now turn into a real united team in order to survive themselves and give hope to everyone else.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Amid the deadly 1941 blockade of Leningrad, a group of rival iceboat athletes must unite to transform an ammunition supply run into a high-stakes mission to rescue trapped orphans.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In November 1941, as the brutal winter sets in and the siege closes around Leningrad, a team of young iceboat athletes embarks on a dangerous trek across fragile ice. Originally tasked with delivering crucial ammunition, their operation dramatically shifts when they discover a group of orphans stranded at an unevacuated orphanage. To navigate the treacherous icy expanse and survive the perilous conditions, former sports rivals must set aside their personal differences and forge a tight-knit team. Together, they fight not only for their own survival, but to rescue the children and bring a beacon of hope to a besieged city.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In November 1941, the harsh winter hits early as the enemy tightens its deadly blockade around Leningrad, cutting off vital supply routes. Desperate for aid, military leaders enlist a group of young iceboat athletes to traverse the thin, newly formed ice across the frozen water. Though skilled on the ice, the athletes are fractured by old regatta rivalries and personal animosities, making cohesion difficult under intense pressure. As they embark on their perilous supply run to deliver ammunition, unforgiving weather conditions and fragile ice constantly threaten to sink their mission. Their original objective changes drastically when they encounter a dire situation: a local orphanage that was never evacuated, leaving defenseless children trapped in the line of fire. Realizing the gravity of the crisis, the athletes pivot from delivering military cargo to orchestrating a daring rescue operation. Navigating extreme temperatures, cracking ice, and constant military threats, the team must learn to trust one another implicitly. Through shared hardship and sheer determination, the former rivals transform into a united front capable of extraordinary heroism. Ultimately, their dangerous journey becomes more than a mission of survival—it stands as an enduring symbol of hope and humanity during one of history's darkest hours.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the backdrop of the brutal 1941 Leningrad blockade, 'Angels of War' follows a group of young iceboat athletes thrust into the harsh realities of World War II. When the city is encircled during a freezing November, these skilled sailors are called upon to utilize their specialized craft across fragile, freshly frozen waters. Initially dispatched on a high-stakes supply run to deliver vital ammunition, their perilous journey takes an unexpected turn when they discover an orphanage filled with children who were left behind during the evacuation. Faced with a harrowing decision, the young athletes abandon personal rivalries and petty disputes from their regatta days, uniting to embark on a rescue mission across the treacherous icy frontier. Combining historical drama, war, and intense human emotion, the story explores themes of self-sacrifice, camaraderie, and resilience as these unlikely heroes risk everything to save innocent lives.

story_structure.climax: The athletes face a critical, high-stakes confrontation on the frozen expanse, putting their lives and newfound teamwork to the ultimate test to pull off the dangerous rescue.
story_structure.conflict: The team's routine ammunition run escalates into a desperate rescue mission to save stranded orphans, forcing former athletic rivals to overcome personal animosities and trust each other.
story_structure.resolution: Having transformed from bitter rivals into a cohesive unit, the team restores hope to those in peril and secures safe passage for the children against incredible odds.
story_structure.introduction: In November 1941, as the winter blockade closes around Leningrad, a group of rival young iceboat athletes is assembled to navigate the thin, newly formed ice on a risky supply mission.
story_structure.risingAction: Navigating treacherous ice conditions and wartime hazards, the team must unite to overcome perilous environmental obstacles, equipment strain, and looming military threats.
